text: The Corporations Nominating Panel must select candidates for interviews to fill a vacancy on the Toronto Hydro Board. Following the interviews, the Corporations Nominating Panel will recommend one candidate for appointment to City Council.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board: THY2-63 THY2-92 THY2-204 THY2-207 THY2-241 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (October 1, 2020) remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Hydro Board.
